caption: The video captures a white dimpled golf ball resting on the flat top of a short cylindrical steel anvil, with a dark hydraulic press ram suspended above it against a green machine housing and a dust-speckled metal bench. The ram descends steadily, closing the air gap until its face meets the ball. As pressure builds, the ball's spherical height shrinks while its sides bulge outward, gradually transforming into a flattened disc. The printed lettering on the ball remains legible across the squashed surface throughout. As the ram travels down, its dark cylinder progressively fills the upper region of the view, while the green housing and the metal bench stay fixed in place. The ram continues its downward travel, pressing the now-thin disc firmly between its face and the anvil top. No bursting, shattering, or ejection occurs within the visible portion, leaving the compression still underway.
